import 'package:openfeature_dart_server_sdk/client.dart';
import 'package:openfeature_dart_server_sdk/evaluation_context.dart';
import 'package:openfeature_dart_server_sdk/feature_provider.dart';
import 'package:openfeature_dart_server_sdk/open_feature_api.dart';
import 'package:openfeature_dart_server_sdk/transaction_context.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final api = OpenFeatureAPI();
  final provider = InMemoryProvider({'enabled': true});
  await api.setProviderAndWait(provider);
  api.setGlobalContext(OpenFeatureEvaluationContext({'application': 'legacy'}));
  final FeatureClient client = api.getClient('legacy');
  await TransactionContextManager().withContext('request', {'request': 'legacy'}, () async {
    final value = await client.getBooleanFlag('enabled', defaultValue: false,
      context: const EvaluationContext(targetingKey: 'subject', attributes: {}));
    if (!value) throw StateError('Legacy flag evaluation failed');
    final details = await client.getBooleanDetails('enabled', defaultValue: false);
    if (!details.value) throw StateError('Legacy details failed');
    const tracking = TrackingEventDetails(value: 1.5, attributes: {'currency': 'USD'});
    final num? numericValue = tracking.value;
    if (numericValue != 1.5) throw StateError('Legacy tracking value changed');
    await client.track('legacy-event', trackingDetails: tracking);
  });
  await client.dispose();
  await OpenFeatureAPI.resetInstance();
}
